metadata.generated_for: AuraRouter declarative routing and intent evaluation
metadata.description: Corpus of declarative intent analysis and multi-factor stacked routing evaluation scenarios

scenarios.name: Simple Code Routing: Highest Rate Limit Headroom Wins
scenarios.description: Task classified as SIMPLE_CODE maps to coding role. Multiple coding models satisfy intent, model with highest rate limit headroom wins.

scenarios.name: Complex Reasoning: BenchWarmer Empirical Benchmark Prior Dominates
scenarios.description: Task classified as COMPLEX_REASONING (complexity 9) triggers Band 2 prior derivation from BenchWarmer benchmarks, favoring high-capability frontier model.

intent_evaluation.raw_prompt: Analyze the Riemannian curvature tensor on a compact 4-manifold and prove the generalized Gauss-Bonnet theorem under Pontryagin classes.

scenarios.name: Sovereignty & Hardware Fit: Cloud and Oversized Local Pruned
scenarios.description: PII prompt with max_vram_gb=24.0. Cloud candidate pruned by SovereigntyFilter; 70B local pruned by CapabilityFilter VRAM check; 14B local model wins.

intent_evaluation.raw_prompt: Confidential patient health analysis: SSN 999-00-1111 diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.

scenarios.name: Goodhart Contamination Defense: Overfitted Model Penalized
scenarios.description: A fine-tuned model with synthetic benchmark contamination is audited with HIGH_CONTAMINATION_RISK and penalized 0.60x, allowing clean model to win.

intent_evaluation.raw_prompt: def solve_graph_isomorphism(g1, g2): # Find graph bijection

scenarios.name: Budget Cap Exhaustion: Cloud Candidates Pruned, Free Tier Wins
scenarios.description: When daily spend budget limit is reached, cloud candidates are pruned by BudgetCapFilter, routing seamlessly to free local tier.

intent_evaluation.raw_prompt: Generate quarterly financial revenue summary from balance sheet data.

scenarios.name: Circuit Breaker Isolation: Tripped Primary Pruned, Secondary Wins
scenarios.description: Primary model circuit breaker is OPEN due to repeated transient failures (503s); pruned by AvailabilityFilter; healthy secondary model wins.

intent_evaluation.raw_prompt: def configure_redis_cluster(nodes: list[str]): # Setup redis cluster topology

scenarios.name: Cache Affinity: Multi-Turn Conversation Sticks to Active Model
scenarios.description: In an active session, candidate model used in previous turn receives a 1.15x cache affinity boost, breaking parity and keeping the session sticky.

intent_evaluation.raw_prompt: Now modify the previous function to handle negative numbers gracefully.

scenarios.name: Cost Elasticity: Trivial Task Routes to Free / Low-Cost Model
scenarios.description: A complexity 1 task triggers high elastic cost penalty (lambda ~0.35) on expensive frontier models, selecting free local model.

intent_evaluation.raw_prompt: Say hello world and tell me what 2 + 2 equals.

scenarios.name: Context Cliff: Small Context Candidate Pruned by CapabilityFilter
scenarios.description: Large prompt exceeds candidate's context limit (4096 tokens); CapabilityFilter prunes small model, routing to large context candidate (128000 tokens).
